title: Test UI flake: ReportNewPage-36692.test.tsx waits two ticks across a cold pinyin-pro import, so Save and Close fail on a busy shard
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a reproducible defect (a recurring CI flake with named failing runs) · Source: fleet (filing request 7148164712 from repo:objectstack#3; outside area:workflow, so seat 3 does not claim it).

## What happens

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportNewPage-36692.test.tsx` waits on `flush()`, which is one `setTimeout(0)` tick (~146), called twice around Save and Close. `ReportNewPage`'s save path awaits `loadHanRomanizer()` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportNewPage.tsx` ~109), which is a cold dynamic `import('pinyin-pro')` the first time. On a busy Test UI shard that import outlasts the ticks, so the Save and Close cases assert before the save has run.

reach: seen failing on two independent PRs today.
- PR #37145, job 138850335703 (Test UI 10/16, run 45507580601 attempt 1, head 88b76bf8; note 7147786346).
- PR #36926, a Test UI shard re-run "after an unrelated flake in `ReportNewPage-36692.test.tsx`".

Each hit costs a shard re-run and can send a PR author chasing a failure their diff did not cause. It is a PR-CI flake, not a merge-queue one, so it is not p0 under the queue-flake rule.

## Expected

The two cases are deterministic: they do not depend on how long the cold import takes.

## Fix

One of:
- Preload `loadHanRomanizer()` at module top, as sibling tests do (`CreateItemDialog.notDerived-13389.test.tsx` ~33).
- Or wait on the observable result (`waitFor` on the `saveAndPublish` mock call, or on the landed route) instead of fixed ticks.

## Acceptance

- The file passes repeatedly under load, for example `--repeat` or a loop of 20 runs with a parallel shard. Without the fix, a delayed `pinyin-pro` mock makes it fail; with the fix, it passes.

Related: #36653 (closed), the same cold-dictionary race in `romanizeHan.test.ts`.

Dedupe: "ReportNewPage-36692", "pinyin-pro flake" and "loadHanRomanizer" (open and closed). The only hits are #36692 (the feature card) and #36653 (another file). No card exists on this test.
